Emma (Marketing): Heads-up — noticed launch posts -> webinar signups converted at 3.9% last 48h vs our benchmark ~6%. dashboard snapshot: https://redwood.app/dash/launch-convo :thinking_face:
Raj (Growth): Hmm, is that UTM vs organic split? Did routing rules change on Friday?
Maria (Analytics): Pulling query now. I see a spike in 'social_mismatch' tag. Could be mis-tagged campaign params.
Maria (Analytics): Query I ran:
```
SELECT channel, count(*)
FROM leads
WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-18' AND created_at <= '2026-03-22'
GROUP BY channel;
```
Liam (Content): I pushed a new headline variant on Thursday — could explain CTR lift but not lead quality drop.
Emma (Marketing): The conversion drop is concentrated in paid social -> form-complete rates down. Cost per lead still roughly the same.
Raj (Growth): Could be a routing debounce — inbound service may have throttled webhooks. ops-bot, any deploys Friday evening?
ops-bot: deploy: inbound-router v2.3.1 promoted to prod at 2026-03-20T18:42Z — included small schema tweak.
Maria (Analytics): That schema tweak caused utm_source to be dropped for ~0.6% of leads — they land as 'unknown' and hit fallback routing.
Emma (Marketing): That would make attribution look like 'direct' so our campaign filters exclude them. Explains the delta.
Liam (Content): Quick ask — can we surface a 'raw_utm' column on the traffic dashboard? Even temporarily as a toggle.
Raj (Growth): Short-term ops: Maria -> add an 'unknown campaign' row to the weekly KPI table and re-run the 3/18-3/22 cohort. Emma -> pause the paid social creative rollout until we confirm.
Maria (Analytics): On it. I'll add the row, re-run the cohort, and export a 100-lead sample to Slack by EOD.
Emma (Marketing): Thanks. Also note for next webinar — we'll A/B subject lines + CTA copy. I'll slot in the test into the playbook.
Raj (Growth): If routing is the root cause, we should add a UTMs check to the deployment checklist. :white_check_mark:
Emma (Marketing): Agreed. Ping me the updated dashboard link when the row is added.
Maria (Analytics): Link: https://redwood.app/dash/launch-convo?view=raw_utm_row — sample exported in thread (CSV).
Liam (Content): Sample preview: 3 rows w/ empty utm_source, landing_page param present.
Emma (Marketing): Good catch. Ops — can inbound-router emit a warning when utm_source is null for paid traffic?
ops-bot: noted. creating ticket #OPS-492 to add telemetry and a null-utm alert.
Emma (Marketing): Perfect. Let's reconvene 10am tomorrow to validate the dashboard change and finalize the paused rollouts. Thanks all :rocket:
